_comment: Canonical named points + areas on the CTF arena (1235x659, mirror line x=617). Shared language: humans use the names in discussion; beacon imports them for strategy targets. Areas are rotated rects: cx/cy center, w/h size, angle degrees CCW. Human-curated (James, 2026-07-27, rev 5). Edit with tools/poi_editor.html.
